About ClearMax

ClearMax Auto Solutions brings a precise, detail-driven approach to automotive care. Every vehicle that comes through our doors is treated with the same attention to detail, from the first inspection to the final inspection before it leaves.

We work with individual vehicle owners who want their car protected and looking its best, and with dealerships that need a dependable partner for consistent, professional results across their inventory.

  • Attention to every detail
  • Quality workmanship
  • Customer-focused service
  • Solutions for dealerships
